name: (04) Obfuscate — 2 Intermediate — Vanish from the Mind's Eye

system.description:
Your stealth is so profound you can disappear in plain sight, winking out of view even as watchers stare straight at you, and remain hidden while you speak and move.

You gain all the benefits of Unseen Presence and may vanish at any time without seeking cover. Declare your intent and make a mass Mental Challenge against any onlookers who care to challenge you (regardless of their Auspex), bidding one Mental Trait per onlooker and throwing one symbol against all; on a success you fade, unseen. Vanishing is not an action but occurs only at the end of a turn. You may also speak aloud and stay hidden, again by winning a mass Mental Challenge - losers hear only a disembodied voice. You still cannot remain invisible while physically interacting, attacking or exerting Presence. Retest Stealth.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
